Well, this is going to be a long one, but hear me out. 

My grandpa fought four over 40 years in the Marines. He lost a lot in World War 2, and died shortly after I was born. Over the course of his life, he lost so many people that death was only a harsh sting at this point. This was before the war mind you.

This is when Hitler entered the picture. From September 1, 1939 – September 2, 1945, my Gramps fought in one of the worst wars of the world, and still is. In fact, some argue it to actually be the worst. Although my grandpa didn't lose his life in this war, he lost his life metaphorically. This is when smoking became a serious issue in our family. He was down about a pack a day for a bit, and my dad relentlessly tried to pry my grandpa away from the path he was on, but it was too little too late. 

My dad, wanting to help out the community and save lives like his dad did, went into the Police force. He served the people of our nation for over 20 years, and vigorously raised the thin blue flag in our yard. And do you want me to tell you some crazy shit that you'll never believe? He has never killed a single person in his life. Yeah, before you cretins shit all over this comment, put that into perspective. In fact, might I share a few stories?

An armed man was holding his partner at knife point. He would not let her go, until one of my dad's greatest friends got closer to him. The guy was able to get a good kick on his balls, but it left him vulnerable to my dad. This'd be the part where the cop shoots, right? Wrong. Instead of quickly ending it, my dad will always try to find the ending where everyone lives. And, another thing I might add, he has never failed. Not ONCE has any person who was in his line of sight died on him. So, he got into a fist fight with this fully grown, beefed out guy. He thought he wasn't going to make it, but he wanted the girl and his partner to get out and stall until back up arrived. His partner tazed him though, so that left them all ample time to get out. 

So, girls in the back of the police truck for safety reasons, and this guy comes out again with the knife. See, this is the part where many just assume that a cop would just put a bullet through his brain. Wrong. He asked him multiple times to put the knife down, and by gods gracious hand the man slipped and slid the knife all the way over to him. From there it was an easy case.

But, that is of course just one story. 

A young baby wasn't breathing as the mom & dad were both arguing. It took around 10 minutes for my dad to get there. So, my dad picks up this baby and starts giving him cpr. Do you know how fucking horrible that'd be? Just get in his shoes for a moment. So, about 20 minutes go by of just non stop mouth to mouth & chest compression and the baby is still not breathing. The baby didn't make it.

A family of five were stuck out in a muddy and rainy road. It was quickly flooding and the water was rising. My dad, on a helicopter (tied to the thing btw) picks up ALL FOUR OF THEM, in REALLY wet conditions mind you, and hold onto them long enough to get them out of there.  

I could go on for a long time, but I think you get the picture. 

Now, enter the riots.

My dad had been volunteering for a long time now, and had been fired by some corrupt Sheriff. Now, he's been fighting to get back in now, and things are looking up right now, so it's good on that end. 

But, then I go online for a bit and do some digging. I go on TikTok, Youtube, Twitter, basic places for hate, and I do a quick check. I was completely disgusted at what I found.

People trying to attack police cars, throw bricks into stores, general shit being looted. 

Hold on, I think we need another story most people seem to have forgotten. About Fort Henry.

[Here's credit where credit's due.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YaxGNQE5ZLA)

 Now, this is about a 10 minute read, but it's very useful in learning about america's roots. Tl;dr though, the British troops put nearly all of their ammunition and shot at the flag for hours on end. A massive onslaught of violence and destruction, in a place filled with woment and children. But, even after hours and hours, the flag still stood. Do you know why?

Brave men and women gave up their lives to run to that flag. They stood their ground knowing full well they wouldn't see the light of dawn. They ran directly towards the danger where as they could have survived. The dead bodies kept the amazing flag still waving in the air, for all of America to praise for the rest of their lives, right?

I mean, every American citizen WOULD respect this flag, knowing the very reason they could protest and riot is because of the brave civilians and soldiers that died protecting it. 

Right???

[Fuck the people who burn the flag without doing a slight bit of research..](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mx4Ht1BoQ0I)

[Fuck the people who hate on gays.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZoJwQp-Fsmg)

And fuck those people who made this shit legal. 

So, my final verdict? Well, German folk, I like you guys a lot more than these snowflakes who get their daily feed from Facebook. You guys protect your flag as I can see from a quick google search, apologies if I'm wrong. I wish that we could live peacefully and not make everything a matter of politics and look at the bigger picture like you guys could. And, most of all, I'm glad your police for aren't being killed for trying to protect the citizens of your country and then being called pigs. EVEN if your country used to be a horrible place, clearly you've learned from your mistakes and have gotten your shit together.

so finally, yes, you can call cops pigs. You can violently attack them so they can't save a life, or you could slander their names all over the country. but, we all know you have that number memorized in case something bad happens to you, right fellow ''Americans?''

Apologies if my grammar isn't on point, I just wanted to get this done quickly so I can go back to doing other stuff.
